verdict.rationale: Inside the product, the documented AI is automated categorization: about 97% of transactions are categorized on the first pass, low-confidence items are left for manual review, and AI actions are logged. Trend summaries, forecasts and natural-language analysis are documented only through external assistants, either in Google Sheets (Gemini/Claude/ChatGPT) or via MCP/CLI connectors, not as a native in-product feature. Missing for 10: a native in-product AI insights or chat surface, AI-generated suggestions beyond categorization (e.g. anomaly or trend alerts), and independent hands-on corroboration.
